title: Support runbook - redacted pilot-support incident rehearsal

supportScope.label: Access
supportScope.purpose: Correlate and contain an unexpected access result without inspecting identity data.

supportScope.label: Roles
supportScope.purpose: Check the expected role boundary against the redacted synthetic observation.

supportScope.label: Chamada
supportScope.purpose: Protect attendance entry and identify a blocked attendance flow.

supportScope.label: Diário
supportScope.purpose: Check the class diary surface and its school boundary.

supportScope.label: Observed inconsistency
supportScope.purpose: Record the difference between expected and observed behavior using redacted references only.

supportScope.label: Data incident
supportScope.purpose: Contain possible loss, alteration or cross-school exposure of attendance data.

supportScope.label: Rollback
supportScope.purpose: Restore the local fixture baseline without deployment or real-data changes.

exclusions: No student name, CPF, NIS, phone, email, raw content or real institution.
No contact with a reporter, owner, substitute or institution.
No deployment, production access, telemetry or CRM.
No SLA, rollout, acceptance or other service promise.
No real attendance data, identity data or institution-specific diagnosis.

classificationRules.classificationRule: Use critical when any critical criterion is present. Use ordinary for questions, visual improvements and feature requests when no critical criterion is present.

existingTechnicalTargets.statement: Existing technical targets remain rehearsal references and are not promises.

humanBinding.t12Statement: T12 is the human binding gate for owner, substitute, channel and calendar.

incident.observedInconsistency: [REDACTED] - the synthetic role visibility result differed from the expected school boundary; raw content is omitted.
incident.severityReason: possible cross-school access and attendance data containment risk
firstResponse: Correlate the incident with SYN-CORR-001 and use only redacted receipt references.
Classify the incident as critical because possible cross-school access can affect data containment.
Contain the rehearsal scope: do not broaden access checks and do not copy raw content.
Protect chamada and Diário state by stopping any synthetic action that could alter attendance.
Record the redacted first-response receipt before escalation.

escalation.trigger: Any critical criterion, including blocked chamada, possible cross-school access, loss or alteration of attendance, or data containment.
actions: Preserve the correlation and containment receipts.
Ask T12 to bind the owner, substitute, channel and calendar before any real support action.
Do not promise a response time, rollout, remediation or deployment.

rollback.trigger: The rehearsal cannot prove the expected access boundary or attendance integrity.
rollback.action: Restore the local redacted fixture baseline and record receipt-redacted-rollback-001.

checks.result: owner, substitute, channel and calendar remain a confirmar

closure.closureRule: Close the rehearsal only after correlation, classification, containment, escalation, receipt and rollback checks are recorded. Do not represent it as a production closure.

servicePromises.statement: This runbook is a rehearsal contract, not an SLA or rollout promise.
